title: Units of measure R1: an organization setting for how many decimal places each standard unit displays
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CajiB6BSQKWowy6YLB

Units of measure, release R1 (ADR-0158 U7). Parent: #35339. The ADR is the governing text: [ADR-0158](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/docs/adr/0158-units-of-measure-standard-unit-table-org-units-quantity-unit-declaration-base-quantity.md) (merged PR #35370, 35bd36082c). Filed on seat 5's word, 2026-11-19.

## What to build
The maintainer ruled ADR-0158 Open item 10 option A, 「组织可改,新开一处设置」 (ruling record on #35339). An organization admin can set the display decimal places of any standard U1 code, for example 3 for grams at a jeweller or 0 for kilograms at a gravel yard. That value lives in a new organization-owned setting place, because `sys_unit` holds only org-added units (U3) and U1 is a closed spec constant. For an org unit, the value is the existing `sys_unit` decimal-places field (U6).

## Constraints from the ADR
- L4: the field's `scale` governs storage and is the ceiling. A unit's decimal places are only its display default; nothing rounds at write by unit.
- The setting is organization-owned, behind the tenant wall, edited by an org admin and audited, like the ratio edit under L1.
- OI2 (#35465) settles `sys_unit`'s fields. This card settles where the standard-code setting lives (a `sys_*` object, or a settings key) and its grants, and amends ADR-0158 (U3 / U6 / L4 and Open item 10).

## Blocked
Blocked-by: #35488

Needs the unit tables (U1 constant, `sys_unit`).

## Done when
An org admin can set and clear the decimal places of a standard code, and a member can read them. Another organization's value is never read. Display (#35490) reads the setting. ADR-0158 records the answer.

## Grade
p2 · area:data · domain:server. The ruled R1 display needs it.
